verses.text: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, But to Your name give glory Because of Your lovingkindness, because of Your truth.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，榮耀不要歸與我們，不要歸與我們；要因你的慈愛和誠實歸在你的名下！

verses.text: Why should the nations say, 'Where, now, is their God?'
verses.textZh: 為何容外邦人說：他們的神在哪裡呢？

verses.text: But our God is in the heavens; He does whatever He pleases.
verses.textZh: 然而，我們的神在天上，都隨自己的意旨行事。

verses.text: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of man's hands.
verses.textZh: 他們的偶像是金的，銀的，是人手所造的，

verses.text: They have mouths, but they cannot speak; They have eyes, but they cannot see;
verses.textZh: 有口卻不能言，有眼卻不能看，

verses.text: They have ears, but they cannot hear; They have noses, but they cannot smell;
verses.textZh: 有耳卻不能聽，有鼻卻不能聞，

verses.text: They have hands, but they cannot feel; They have feet, but they cannot walk; They cannot make a sound with their throat.
verses.textZh: 有手卻不能摸，有腳卻不能走，有喉嚨也不能出聲。

verses.text: Those who make them will become like them, Everyone who trusts in them.
verses.textZh: 造他的要和他一樣；凡靠他的也要如此。

verses.text: O Israel, trust in the LORD; He is their help and their shield.
verses.textZh: 以色列啊，你要倚靠耶和華！他是你的幫助和你的盾牌。

verses.text: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD; He is their help and their shield.
verses.textZh: 亞倫家啊，你們要倚靠耶和華！他是你們的幫助和你們的盾牌。

verses.text: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD; He is their help and their shield.
verses.textZh: 你們敬畏耶和華的，要倚靠耶和華！他是你們的幫助和你們的盾牌。

verses.text: The LORD has been mindful of us; He will bless [us]; He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.textZh: 耶和華向來眷念我們；他還要賜福給我們：要賜福給以色列的家，賜福給亞倫的家。

verses.text: He will bless those who fear the LORD, The small together with the great.
verses.textZh: 凡敬畏耶和華的，無論大小，主必賜福給他。

verses.text: May the LORD give you increase, You and your children.
verses.textZh: 願耶和華叫你們和你們的子孫日見加增。

verses.text: May you be blessed of the LORD, Maker of heaven and earth.
verses.textZh: 你們蒙了造天地之耶和華的福！

verses.text: The heavens are the heavens of the LORD, But the earth He has given to the sons of men.
verses.textZh: 天，是耶和華的天；地，他卻給了世人。

verses.text: The dead do not praise the LORD, Nor [do] any who go down into silence;
verses.textZh: 死人不能讚美耶和華；下到寂靜中的也都不能。

verses.text: But as for us, we will bless the LORD From this time forth and forever. Praise the LORD!
verses.textZh: 但我們要稱頌耶和華，從今時直到永遠。你們要讚美耶和華！
